saw_lines: Flannel and outerwear buyers choose by fit and fabric, then come back to replace the one that wore out.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides if this fabric is worth a click.
Your site shows 100,000+ online orders, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number. Put 100,000+ orders on the creative and in the first line of three ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 100,000+ online orders, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number. New buyers have no reason to trust a brand they just found. Put 100,000+ orders on the creative and in the first line of three ads.
Your site offers 20% off 3 tees, yet 0 of 14 ads mention percent off, so a first time buyer has no reason to act. Put Grab any 3 tees, save 20% in the first line of three new tee ads.

Your site lists prices from $36.00 to $165.00, yet 0 of 28 ads mention price. A buyer comparing tee and jacket has nothing to weigh, so they scroll on. Lead one ad with the jacket price and what it replaces.

Your 5 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the item in the picture. A buyer who taps a henley ad lands among every category. Point each one to the exact product it shows, like the Sawpit Henley.

ads_1: Paid creative leads with 100,000+ orders and the 3 tees offer, product named first
